result.brief: 提出以预训练 DINO 语义特征为预测空间的世界-动作模型，通过残差世界预测与时间尺度预测联合塑造共享视觉-语言主干，提升操作策略的泛化与鲁棒性。
result.reason: Studies prediction spaces for world-action modeling, using DINO semantic features as future supervision; contributes representation/prediction-space design, though main evaluation is robot policy.
